bio.text: William Lindstedt, a Democrat, represents Colorado Senate District 25, which includes Adams, Broomfield and Weld counties; he was appointed to the seat on December 30, 2025.
Before joining the Senate, Lindstedt served in the Colorado House of Representatives and on the Broomfield City Council.

According to Ballotpedia, he earned a B.A. in political science from the University of Colorado at Denver and has worked as an assistant bench jeweler, a community organizer and a staffer with the Colorado House of Representatives.
